info.title: [VGE-D-TTD01] Title Trial Deck 01 “Touken Ranbu -ONLINE- 2021” ｜ ｜ Card List ｜ Cardfight!! Vanguard Trading Card Game | Official Website

cards.text:
D-TTD01/001EN
Kashuu Kiyomitsu Kiwame
Normal Unit｜ Touken Ranbu｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[CONT](VC):During your turn, if you have no face up cards in your damage zone, this unit gets [Power] +10000.
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1] &[Soul-Blast 1], look at the top card of your deck, put it on the top or bottom of your deck, and draw a card.

D-TTD01/002EN
Kashuu Kiyomitsu Toku
Normal Unit｜ Touken Ranbu｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
Updated: Text
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed by riding from "Kashuu Kiyomitsu Sentou", search your deck for up to one "Special Investigation: Keiou Koufu", reveal it and put it into hand, and shuffle the deck.
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Kashuu Kiyomitsu Kiwame", search your deck for up to one "Yamatonokami Yasusada", reveal it and put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
[CONT](RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000.

D-TTD01/003EN
Kashuu Kiyomitsu Sentou
Normal Unit｜ Touken Ranbu｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
Updated: Text
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Kashuu Kiyomitsu Toku", [COST][reveal a grade 3 card with "Kashuu Kiyomitsu" in its card name from ride deck], and put a Forge token in your order zone.
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Kashuu Kiyomitsu Toku", look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your soul.
[CONT](RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000.

[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.

Yamatonokami Yasusada
Normal Unit｜ Touken Ranbu｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[ACT](RC):[COST][Counter-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn. If your vanguard is "Kashuu Kiyomitsu Kiwame", it gets [Power] +10000 instead of +5000.

D-TTD01/008EN
Heshikiri Hasebe
Normal Unit｜ Touken Ranbu｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), look at two cards from the top of your deck, and put them on the top of your deck in any order.

D-TTD01/009EN
Imanotsurugi
Normal Unit｜ Touken Ranbu｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel(You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck)
[AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC), [COST][discard a card from your hand], choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle.

D-TTD01/012EN
Atsushi Toushirou
Trigger Unit｜ Touken Ranbu｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(If revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Critical] +1 until end of turn! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +1000 until end of turn!)

D-TTD01/013EN
Hakata Toushirou
Trigger Unit｜ Touken Ranbu｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 5000
(If revealed as a trigger, draw a card! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn!)

D-TTD01/014EN
Midare Toushirou
Trigger Unit｜ Touken Ranbu｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(If revealed as a trigger, all of your front row units get [Power] +10000 until end of turn!)

D-TTD01/015EN
Gokotai
Trigger Unit｜ Touken Ranbu｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(You may only have up to four [Heal] triggers in a deck. If revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn. Then, if the number of cards in your damage zone is equal to or more than your opponent's, choose a card from your damage zone, and heal it!)

D-TTD01/016EN
Kashuu Kiyomitsu Shinken Hissatsu
Trigger Order｜ Touken Ranbu｜ Grade 0｜ Power ｜ Shield
(You may only have one [Over] trigger in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, remove that card, draw a card, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +100 Million until end of turn! If revealed during drive check, activate its additional effect!)
Additional Effect－All of your units get [Critical] +1 until end of turn!
Play Effect (Resolve this effect when played as an order!) - Choose one of your vanguards, until end of turn, it gets [Critical] +1, and if your damage zone has five or more cards, all of your units get [Power] +10000!
